_comment: The site's top navigation, built fresh on every page by js/nav-render.js rather than hand-copied into all seven HTML files. 'href' always uses the full, portable form - 'index.html#member-schools' rather than a bare '#member-schools' - because a bare anchor only makes sense on the page that anchor lives on. The renderer strips the 'index.html' prefix back off automatically when a link points at a section on the page currently being viewed, which is what keeps a click on Standings a smooth in-page scroll on the home page itself, rather than a full reload of a page you're already on. A top-level item with 'children' becomes a dropdown; one without is a plain link. Four more top-level items may be appended automatically, one per published Extra Page - that is not represented here, since whether they exist depends on data/pages/custom-*.json rather than this file.
